hero.title: Bukhara State Technical University
hero.subtitle: Established under Presidential Decree PP-22, BSTU represents the unified academic strength of Bukhara's technological institutions. Empowered with complete academic and financial autonomy since 2026, we are engineering a sustainable, digital future for Uzbekistan and Central Asia.
hero.autonomyDesc: Operating as a fully self-governing university since January 1, 2026.
hero.qsDesc: Active candidate listed in the official QS Top Universities global registry.
hero.legacyDesc: Successor of Bukhara's earliest engineering faculty founded in 1959.

identity.title: Our Identity
identity.desc1: Formed through the integration of the Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute and the Bukhara Institute of Natural Resources Management (Presidential Resolution No. PP-22), BSTU brings together the region's elite scholars, researchers, and campus facilities.
identity.desc2: Our university aims to become a major technological base in Uzbekistan, equipping students with deep engineering expertise, research capabilities, and global industrial integration, partnering directly with conglomerates like Uzbekneftegaz JSC.

goals.title: Mission & Vision
goals.missionDesc: To deliver premier technical education, drive pioneering scientific research, and produce elite engineering graduates who can introduce advanced green technologies, petrochemical synthesis solutions, and digital infrastructures in national sectors.
goals.visionDesc: To secure a prominent position among the top 1,000 global universities in the QS World Rankings by 2030, establishing BSTU as Central Asia's primary research hub for industrial digitalization and energy-efficient resource management.

values.title: Core Values
values.integrityDesc: Upholding international ethics, transparency in ECTS grading, and zero tolerance for corruption through our Compliance Control systems.
values.innovationDesc: Fostering student startup talent, supporting national patented technologies, and driving digital engineering solutions.
values.inclusivityDesc: Supporting diverse international students, executing dual-degrees, and offering specialized inclusive training for physically challenged youth.

rector.title: Transforming Technical Education for the Global Era
rector.quote1: Welcome to Bukhara State Technical University. Our university enters 2026 with complete academic and financial autonomy, allowing us to build modern credit-based ECTS curricula aligned with leading European technical standards. By merging the regional engineering and natural resource institutes, we have built a powerful scientific hub.
rector.quote2: We believe that true engineering cannot be taught in isolation. That is why our students actively collaborate with national enterprises, conduct scientific research in patented petrochemical formulas, and participate in double-degree programs with Latvia, Belarus, and Turkey. We prepare elite technical specialists ready for global challenges.
rector.appealTitle: Rector's Special Appeal: Safeguarding Our Youth
rector.appealQuote: Today, global processes are creating many factors that directly affect the lives of young people. Alongside the endless opportunities of technology, harmful vices also enter without limits. Among these, it is obvious that the most dangerous is drug addiction and related crimes. This vice slowly separates a person from health, consciousness, goals, and dreams.
rector.studentsDesc: Each of you is the force prepared for the scientific, technical, and economic development of our country. Discipline, vigilance, independent thinking, and determination are required from you. The student period is the most precious time—fill it with knowledge, research, and high goals. Stay true to your dreams and chosen profession.
rector.parentsDesc: Monitoring our children's mental state, extracurricular activities, friends, and interests is the most effective measure for their safety. A single word of advice, a minute of conversation sometimes prevents big mistakes. Stay involved in their academic journey and provide constant guidance.
rector.teachersDesc: Your scientific potential, life experience, and educational advice create a solid foundation in the minds of young people. Preventing drug addiction is not just a restriction, but above all, a spiritual strength, collective responsibility, and a conscious way of life. Let us strengthen a healthy environment at our university together.

timeline.title: Our Historic Journey
timeline.subtitle: From our evening technical roots in 1959 to a fully autonomous, leading state technical university.
timeline.year1959Desc: Establishment of the Bukhara Evening General Technical Faculty, laying the foundation for engineering education in the Bukhara oasis to support regional mining and industrial operations.
timeline.year1978Desc: Reorganized as the Bukhara Institute of Food and Light Industry Technology, expanding into dedicated chemical technology, textile machinery, and light industry engineering programs.
timeline.year2011Desc: Evolved into the Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute (BETI), establishing major departments in oil & gas refining, automation, and computer science.
timeline.year2025Desc: By Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. PP-22, Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute and Bukhara Institute of Natural Resources Management merge to form Bukhara State Technical University.
timeline.year2026Desc: Effective January 1, 2026, BSTU is granted full academic, organizational, and financial independence to implement independent credit systems and accelerate QS rankings.

faq.title: Answers to Your Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: When was Bukhara State Technical University (BSTU) established?
faq.a1: BSTU was officially established in January 2025 by Presidential Resolution No. PP-22, uniting the Bukhara Engineering-Technological Institute and the Bukhara Institute of Natural Resources Management.
faq.q2: What main faculties are available at BSTU?
faq.a2: The university is structured into 4 faculties and 24 departments, including Chemical & Food Technologies, Oil & Gas Technology, Engineering & Construction, Power Engineering & ICT, Textile & Light Industry, and Natural Resources Management.
faq.q3: Does BSTU offer joint or double-degree educational programs?
faq.a3: Yes, BSTU active partnerships offer double-degree and joint educational programs with leading technical universities in Latvia, Malaysia, Belarus, and Russia.
faq.q4: What is the Advanced Engineering School at BSTU?
faq.a4: Established in cooperation with Uzbekneftegaz JSC, the Advanced Engineering School aims to provide energy sector students with hands-on, high-tech industrial training and direct career pathways.
faq.q5: Where is the main university campus located?
faq.a5: The university campus is located at 15 Q. Murtazoyev Street, Bukhara city, Uzbekistan.

electrical-power-engineering.history:
The Department of Electrical and Power Engineering was established in 1977 under the name 'General Electrical Engineering', separated from the 'General Engineering Sciences' department under the leadership of M.T. Turdiev. Since 1978, evening classes in 'Electricity Supply for Industrial Enterprises, Cities and Agriculture' were offered, followed by daytime classes in 'Power Engineering' in 1985, and postgraduate programs in 2000.
The department was led by M.T. Turdiyev (1977-1985, 1994-2005), A.M. Abdullayev (1985-1994), N.N. Sadullayev (2005-2011), M.I. Maxmudov (2011-2018), and I.I. Xafizov (2018-2019).
In 2019, three separate departments were created: 'Electrical Mechanics and Technologies' (led by Assoc. Prof. I.I. Xafizov), 'Power Engineering' (led by Assoc. Prof. R.B. Jalilov), and 'Energy Audit' (led by M.I. Mahmudov).
Following structural reforms in the 2024-2025 academic year, these three departments were merged into the single 'Department of Electrical and Power Engineering'. N.N. Mirzayev served as head in 2024-2025, and Assoc. Prof. Latipov Saidmurod Tuyg'unovich has been leading it since the start of the 2025-2026 academic year.
electrical-power-engineering.research: The department has a high scientific potential with 2 Doctors of Sciences, 3 PhDs, 6 Senior Lecturers, and several independent researchers. Research is funded by a 500 million UZS state grant for creating wind energy systems, and active business contracts with 9 industrial enterprises amounting to 92 million UZS. The department also has access to modern energy auditing equipment (Portaflow 330, Testo 330-1LL, Fluke 435 II) via academic innovation grants.

architecture.history: In April 2008, the First President of Uzbekistan, I.A. Karimov, visited Bukhara and instructed the creation of an architecture training program in Bukhara to preserve national heritage and design modern structures. In May 2008, the 'Architecture and Civil Engineering' faculty was established, and in August 2009, the 'Department of Architecture' was formed. Today, the department has 20 academic staff members, including 1 Doctor of Sciences, 4 Candidates of Sciences, and 5 Senior Lecturers.
architecture.research: The department carries out active scientific research in restoration of historical brick structures, building physics, climate-adapted design, and green building technologies in Uzbekistan. Research is carried out in close collaboration with the Bukhara Regional Administration of Cultural Heritage and construction companies.

Today, the department has 32 academic staff members, including 2 Doctors of Sciences, 15 Candidates of Sciences, and 15 Senior Lecturers/Assistants.

Over 7 textbooks, 4 monographs, and 2 patents have been published recently.

monitoring-internal-control.name: Monitoring and inner Control Department

monitoring-internal-control.about: In its activities, the department complies with the Laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan, Decrees, Resolutions, and Orders of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, decisions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan, this Regulation, institute orders and Council decisions, as well as other normative legal acts.
functions: Directly leads the department, organizes the work of the department staff, and is fully responsible for the implementation of tasks and functions assigned to the department in accordance with this Regulation.
Implements measures to improve the department's activities and enhance the qualifications of himself/herself and the staff.

Monitors the timely execution of legislative documents and assignments by divisions through the 'Ijro.gov.uz' and 'Edo.ijro.uz' systems, reviews the effectiveness of their implementation at meetings of the Institute Rector and Council, and submits consolidated reports with relevant proposals;

Proposes suggestions to the Rector aimed at increasing the efficiency of organizing the implementation of legislative documents and assignments, as well as strengthening the responsibility of officials in ensuring discipline of execution within institute divisions.

Submits proposals to the institute leadership regarding disciplinary actions against responsible employees in the institute’s departments, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments who violate execution discipline.

Organizes systematic and targeted study of the execution discipline situation in the institute’s departments, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments. Prepares documents related to department activities, ensures consideration of submitted drafts, and prepares proposals.
Reviews appeals from individuals and legal entities related to department activities and fully complies with execution discipline.
Develops and ensures the implementation of measures to further improve the department's work.

Controls timely receipt, registration according to established procedures, and delivery to the institute leadership and its structural divisions of letters and documents received from the Administration of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, the Cabinet of Ministers, other ministries, and agencies.
Organizes and coordinates the quality work activity of employees in accordance with the department's work plan and assigned service duties.
Monitors documentation of management activities, sending letters, and preparation and formalization of internal documents.
Provides appropriate practical and methodological assistance for record-keeping in the institute and its divisions, and supervises their work.
Cooperates with divisions to improve established procedures in record-keeping and document management.
Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of tasks assigned to the institute by decrees, resolutions, and orders of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan;
Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of tasks assigned to the institute by resolutions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan;

Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of tasks assigned to the institute based on protocols of meetings held by the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan and assignments from the Administration of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan;

Conducts systematic monitoring of the execution of tasks assigned to the institute by documents of the Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovations (orders, joint decisions, assignments, letters, etc.);
Systematically monitors the quality and timely execution of orders of the Rector of the institute by structural divisions, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments;

Based on the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan 'On Appeals of Physical and Legal Persons' and the Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 341, the department continuously monitors and supervises timely and proper consideration of appeals by institute divisions;
Immediately informs the Rector about any violations of deadlines and procedures for consideration of appeals by responsible executors;
Provides the Rector with necessary information and data on execution of legislative documents, assignments, and appeals of physical and legal persons;

Regularly analyzes the execution status of tasks assigned to the institute in laws, decrees, protocols of meetings with the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, resolutions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers, and ministry documents; identifies shortcomings and issues requiring urgent resolution and submits them for discussion at meetings with the Rector and the Council;

Regularly analyzes the implementation of institute orders by departments, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments; identifies urgent issues and submits them for discussion to the Rector and institute Council;

Registers and examines incoming appeals (applications, complaints, suggestions) from physical and legal persons through the President’s Virtual Reception, Prime Minister’s Virtual Receptions, ministries, and other relevant organizations in accordance with established procedures and deadlines, and ensures delivery to the executor after content review;
Controls that responsible employees send reply letters (to the author of the appeal, relevant organizations, and agencies) within the established deadlines;

Develops the schedule for reception of representatives of physical and legal persons by heads of divisions and responsible employees, and organizes oral receptions at the institute based on this schedule (approved by the Rector);
Conducts monthly, quarterly, and annual analyses on the status of consideration of appeals received by the institute, and reports to the Rector and Council meetings;
Prepares analytical reports on timely consideration of appeals by the institute’s divisions, technical schools, lyceums, faculties, and departments, and submits quarterly reports to the Ministry;
Controls documents, assignments, and execution of tasks in lyceums and technical schools within the institute’s organizational structure;
Carries out systematic activities related to appeals of individuals and legal entities directly related to the department's activities and strengthens execution discipline.

digital-educational-technologies.name: Digital Educational Technologies Centre
digital-educational-technologies.headTitle: Director of the Digital Technologies Center
digital-educational-technologies.about: The current DET traces its origins back to the 1980s. Initially, in 1978, the 'Computing Center' was established under the Department of 'Applied Mathematics' at the Bukhara Food and Light Industry Technology Institute. Its material and technical base consisted of a computer classroom equipped with ES-1035, version 3, later replaced by IBM PC.AT/XT computers. Extensive work is underway at the university to automate the educational process. Wi-Fi zones have been established on campus. There are 22 computer classrooms with approximately 800 computers in total.

Network Management Department

Information Security Department
Extensive work is underway at the university to automate the educational process.
Within DET, a group of 'Developers' has been formed who develop and maintain programs such as the electronic journal, electronic library, distance learning system 'Moodle,' and other applications.
Wi-Fi zones have been established on campus for student internet access.
Bukhara State Technical University is connected to a corporate network via optical cable in partnership with Bukhara Telecom.
The center maintains contractual relationships with clients and suppliers of technical resources and equipment based on the types of services and works provided.

scientific-research-department.name: Department of Scientific Research, Innovations, and Training of Scientific-Pedagogical Staff
scientific-research-department.about: The Department of Scientific Research and Training of Scientific-Pedagogical Staff was established in 1982. It is managed by the Head of Department and operates within the scope of the Vice-Rector for Scientific Work and Innovations of the university. Up to the present day, the department has been led by various professors and instructors.

Effectively utilizing the university's scientific potential to solve scientific and scientific-technical problems in the development of the national economy;
Developing scientific research in the creation of new materials, equipment, and technologies;
Improving the quality of specialists being trained by applying the results of scientific research to the educational process;
Strengthening the material and technical base of scientific research work;
Integrating efforts to create competitive technologies and equipment based on the development of scientific and technical cooperation.

masters-department.name: Master’s Department

youth-spirituality-enlightenment.name: Department of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment
youth-spirituality-enlightenment.headTitle: Director of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment Department
youth-spirituality-enlightenment.about: The main task of the Department of Youth Affairs, Spirituality, and Enlightenment at the institute is to convey all the teachings of our President regarding spirituality, enlightenment, and national ideology to the youth. The main goal is to nurture students in the spirit of loyalty to national and universal values.
functions: Forming students into true citizens of the independent Republic of Uzbekistan based on national and universal values;

Developing students’ socio-political and legal consciousness, and expanding their critical and analytical thinking skills;
Educating students about the consequences of negative traits such as injustice, bribery, and localism;

civil-and-labor-protection.name: Department of Civil and Labor Protection
civil-and-labor-protection.headTitle: Head of the Department of Civil and Labor Protection
civil-and-labor-protection.about: The Department of Civil and Labor Protection coordinates civil defense plans, emergency drills, safety protocols, and labor protection engineering parameters across the campus. It supervises industrial hygiene, hazard prevention, and accident investigations.

trade-union-committee.name: Trade Union Committee
trade-union-committee.headTitle: Chairman of the Trade Union Committee
trade-union-committee.about: The Trade Union Committee is dedicated to representing and protecting the social-economic, labor, and occupational safety rights and interests of its members among staff and students at Bukhara State Technical University.
functions: To achieve the conclusion of collective agreements and oversee their implementation;

The purpose of the Trade Union is to represent and protect the social-economic, labor, and occupational safety rights and interests of its members.

software-engineering.name: Software Engineering
software-engineering.detailedDescription: The Software Engineering program at Bukhara State Technical University prepares students to design, develop, and maintain complex software systems. Students learn software design patterns, object-oriented design, Agile methodologies, cloud computing, database structures, and advanced mobile application development. The curriculum emphasizes industry-aligned practical projects.
requirements: High scores in Mathematics and Physics exams
accreditations: Uzbek Ministry of Higher Education Accreditation

cybersecurity.name: Information Systems Security & Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.detailedDescription: The Information Systems Security & Cybersecurity program at BSTU provides comprehensive education in protecting networks, computers, programs, and data from attack, damage, or unauthorized access. Students study cryptography, ethical hacking, digital forensics, network security protocols, and security compliance standards. Practical training includes laboratory simulations of cyber-attack scenarios.
requirements: High scores in national Mathematics and Informatics exams
accreditations: Ministry of Digital Technologies Professional Certificate

power-engineering.name: Power Engineering
power-engineering.detailedDescription: Power Engineering covers electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption. The curriculum focuses on electric grids, high-voltage technology, power electronics, and renewable energy integrations (solar, wind). Students practice in advanced power electronics laboratories and learn how to manage smart grids and power stations.
requirements: High scores in national Physics and Mathematics entrance exams
accreditations: IEEE Power & Energy Society Audit Endorsement
National Smart Grid Standard Alignment Certificate

mechanical-engineering.name: Mechanical Engineering
mechanical-engineering.detailedDescription: The Mechanical Engineering program at BSTU provides a comprehensive background in machine design, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, robotics, and automated manufacturing systems. Students study computer-aided engineering (CAD/CAM/CAE), materials science, and machine assembly. The program trains engineers to build and optimize mechanical systems for industrial operations.
requirements: High scores in Mathematics and Physics exams

oil-gas-engineering.name: Oil and Gas Engineering
oil-gas-engineering.detailedDescription: Oil and Gas Engineering is offered by the Faculty of Technology with department-based academic and practical training.
requirements: High scores in Chemistry and Mathematics exams
oil-gas-engineering.description: Oil and Gas Engineering is offered by the Faculty of Technology with department-based academic and practical training.

automotive-engineering.name: Automotive Engineering
automotive-engineering.detailedDescription: The Automotive Engineering program covers vehicle design, engine performance, transmission systems, automotive electronics, and assembly logistics. Given the scale of automotive manufacturing in Uzbekistan, this program prepares engineers to lead design and assembly lines, conduct vehicle safety audits, and implement smart transport technologies.
requirements: High scores in Physics and Mathematics exams

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.detailedDescription: The Architecture program is a rigorous 5-year curriculum blending art, history, science, and technology. Students learn architectural drawing, 3D modeling, sustainable design principles, building safety codes, and urban design. The coursework includes studio projects where students design buildings and public spaces, responding to cultural, environmental, and technological requirements.
curriculum: History of World and National Architecture
requirements: BSTU Architectural Drawing & Sketching Entrance Exam

economics.name: Economics
economics.detailedDescription: The Economics program gives students the analytical and quantitative skills to understand economic systems, market behaviors, and corporate finances. The curriculum covers econometrics, public finance, corporate strategy, international trade, and resource management. Students learn to use statistical software (SPSS, R, Excel) to model market trends and evaluate industrial investment projects.
requirements: High scores in Mathematics and Social Sciences/History exams

construction.name: Construction
construction.detailedDescription: The Construction Engineering program trains professionals in building design, construction management, and structural safety. Coursework covers soil mechanics, concrete and steel structures, quantity surveying, project scheduling, and occupational safety. Graduates are equipped to supervise construction sites, estimate project budgets, and design robust infrastructures.
requirements: High scores in national Mathematics and Physics entrance exams
Understanding of construction graphics and CAD tools

metallurgy.name: Metallurgy
metallurgy.detailedDescription: Metallurgy deals with the extraction of metals from ores, their refining, alloying, and fabrication into useful products. Students learn about physical and chemical metallurgy, material characterization techniques (microscopy, XRD), heat treatment processes, and non-destructive testing (NDT). The program highlights alloy engineering and metal recycling.
requirements: High scores in Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics entrance exams

food-technology.name: Food Technology
food-technology.detailedDescription: Food Technology is offered by the Faculty of Technology with department-based academic and practical training.
requirements: High scores in national Chemistry and Biology exams
Strict compliance with hygiene and lab guidelines

textile-engineering.name: Textile Engineering
textile-engineering.detailedDescription: Textile Engineering focuses on the manufacturing of yarn, fabric, and garments from cotton, wool, and synthetic fibers. Uzbekistan is a major cotton producer, making this program highly relevant. Students study fiber physics, spinning and weaving technologies, textile dyeing, and computer-aided pattern design (CAD) for fashion and industrial garments.
requirements: High scores in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics entrance exams

hero.title: Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti
hero.subtitle: Prezidentning PP-22-sonli qaroriga muvofiq tashkil etilgan BuxDTU Buxoro texnologiya institutlarining birlashgan ilmiy kuchini ifodalaydi. 2026-yildan to'liq akademik va moliyaviy mustaqillikka ega bo'lib, biz O'zbekiston va Markaziy Osiyo uchun raqamli kelajakni muhandislik asosida barpo etmoqdamiz.
hero.autonomyDesc: 2026-yil 1-yanvardan boshlab to'liq o'zini o'zi boshqaradigan universitet sifatida faoliyat yuritmoqda.
hero.qsDesc: Nufuzli QS Top Universities xalqaro reyting ro'yxatiga kiritilgan faol nomzod.
hero.legacyDesc: 1959-yilda tashkil etilgan Buxoro birinchi kechki umumtexnika fakulteti vorisi.

identity.title: Bizning shaxsiyatimiz
identity.desc1: Buxoro muhandislik-texnologiya instituti va Buxoro tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish instituti birlashishi natijasida tashkil etilgan (Prezidentning PP-22-sonli qarori) BuxDTU mintaqaning eng elita olimlari va zamonaviy o'quv binolarini birlashtiradi.
identity.desc2: Universitetimiz O'zbekistonda yirik texnologik baza bo'lishni, talabalarni chuqur muhandislik bilimlari bilan ta'minlashni hamda o'zbekneftegaz AJ kabi sanoat gigantlari bilan hamkorlik qilishni maqsad qilgan.

goals.title: Missiya va strategiya
goals.missionDesc: Yuqori sifatli muhandislik ta'limini taqdim etish, ilg'or ilmiy tadqiqotlar olib borish va mamlakat sanoat tarmoqlariga ekologik toza va raqamli texnologiyalarni joriy qila oladigan muhandis kadrlarni tayyorlash.
goals.visionDesc: 2030-yilga kelib QS xalqaro reytingida dunyoning eng kuchli 1000 ta universiteti qatoridan joy olish, Markaziy Osiyoda sanoat raqamlashtirish bo'yicha yetakchi tadqiqot markaziga aylanish.

values.title: Asosiy qadriyatlarimiz
values.integrityDesc: Xalqaro etika me'yorlariga rioya qilish, baholash tizimida shaffoflik va korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashish tizimi.
values.innovationDesc: Talabalarning startap g'oyalarini qo'llab-quvvatlash, milliy patentlashtirilgan texnologiyalarni rivojlantirish.
values.inclusivityDesc: Xorijiy talabalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash, qo'shma ta'lim dasturlarini amalga oshirish va imkoniyati cheklangan yoshlar uchun sharoitlar yaratish.

rector.title: Global davr uchun texnik ta'limni transformatsiya qilish
rector.quote1: Buxoro davlat texnika universitetiga xush kelibsiz. Universitetimiz 2026-yilga to'liq akademik va moliyaviy mustaqillik bilan qadam qo'ydi, bu esa bizga Yevropa ta'lim standartlariga mos keladigan zamonaviy ECTS kredit tizimini joriy etish imkonini beradi. Birlashgan ilmiy markaz sifatida biz ulkan imkoniyatlar yaratdik.
rector.quote2: Biz haqiqiy muhandislik amaliyotdan uzilgan holda o'rganilmasligiga ishonamiz. Shuning uchun talabalarimiz yirik sanoat korxonalari bilan hamkorlik qiladilar va Latviya, Belarus, Turkiya kabi davlatlar bilan qo'shma dasturlarda ishtirok etadilar. Biz global muammolarga tayyor mutaxassislarni tayyorlaymiz.
rector.profileBtn: Rektor faoliyati va yutuqlari bilan tanishish
rector.appealQuote: Bugungi kunda dunyoda yoshlar hayotiga ta'sir qiluvchi zararli illatlar cheklovsiz kirib kelmoqda. Shular orasida eng xavflisi — giyohvandlik va u bilan bog'liq jinoyatlardir. Bu illat insonni sog'liq, ong va maqsadlardan sezdirmasdan uzoqlashtiradi.
rector.studentsDesc: Sizlar mamlakatimiz ilmiy-texnik rivoji uchun tayyorlanayotgan kuchsizlar. Sizdan tartib-intizom, hushyorlik va mustaqil fikrlash talab etiladi. Talabalik davrini bilim va yuksak maqsadlar bilan to'ldirish sizning qo'lingizda. Vaqtinchalik qiziqishlarga berilmang. Tanlagan kasbingizga sodiq bo'ling.
rector.parentsDesc: Farzandlarimizning ruhiy holati va darsdan tashqari mashg'ulotlarini kuzatib borish — xavfsizlik yo'lidagi eng samarali choradir. Bir daqiqa samimiy suhbat ba'zan katta xatolarning oldini oladi.
rector.teachersDesc: Sizning hayotiy tajribangiz yoshlar ongida mustahkam poydevor yaratadi. Giyohvandlikning oldini olish faqat cheklov emas, balki jamoaviy mas'uliyatdir. Universitetimizda sog'lom muhitni birgalikda mustahkamlaylik. Har bir talabaga e'tiborli bo'laylik.

timeline.title: Bizning tarixiy yo'limiz
timeline.subtitle: 1959-yildagi kechki texnika fakultetidan mustaqil yetakchi davlat texnika universitetigacha bo'lgan yo'l.
timeline.year1959Desc: Buxoro vohasida muhandislik ta'limiga poydevor qo'ygan Buxoro kechki umumtexnika fakultetining tashkil etilishi.
timeline.year1978Desc: Buxoro oziq-ovqat va yengil sanoat texnologiyasi instituti sifatida qayta tashkil etilishi, kimyo va muhandislik yo'nalishlarining kengayishi.
timeline.year2011Desc: Buxoro muhandislik-texnologiya instituti (BMTI) sifatida qayta tashkil etilib, neft-gaz va kompyuter fanlari kafedralari tashkil etilishi.
timeline.year2025Desc: Prezident qarori bilan BMTI va Buxoro tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish institutlari birlashtirilib, yagona BuxDTU tashkil etildi.
timeline.year2026Desc: 2026-yil 1-yanvardan boshlab universitetga mustaqil ta'lim tizimini joriy etish uchun to'liq akademik, tashkiliy va moliyaviy mustaqillik berildi.

faq.title: Sizni qiziqtirgan savollarga javoblar
faq.q1: Buxoro davlat texnika universiteti qachon tashkil etilgan?
faq.a1: BuxDTU rasman 2025-yil yanvar oyida Prezidentning PP-22-sonli Qarori bilan tashkil etilgan bo'lib, Buxoro muhandislik-texnologiya instituti va Buxoro tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish institutini birlashtirdi.
faq.a2: Universitet tarkibida 4 ta fakultet va 24 ta kafedra faoliyat ko'rsatmoqda, jumladan kimyoviy va oziq-ovqat texnologiyalari, neft va gaz texnologiyasi, muhandislik va qurilish, energetika va AKT, to'qimachilik va yengil sanoat hamda tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish.
faq.q3: BuxDTU qo'shma diplom dasturlarini taklif etadimi?
faq.a3: Ha, BuxDTU Latviya, Malayziya, Belarus va Rossiyaning yetakchi texnik universitetlari bilan hamkorlikda qo'shma diplom va ikki tomonlama ta'lim dasturlarini taklif etadi.
faq.q4: BuxDTU ning Ilg'or muhandislik maktabi nima?
faq.a4: Uzbekneftegaz AJ bilan hamkorlikda tashkil etilgan Ilg'or muhandislik maktabi energetika sohasi talabalari uchun amaliy, yuqori texnologiyali sanoat tayyorgarligi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishga joylashish imkoniyatlarini taqdim etadi.
faq.a5: Universitet kampusi Buxoro shahri, Murtazoyev ko'chasi, 15-uyda joylashgan.

faculty-of-technology.name: Texnologiya fakulteti
faculty-of-technology.about: Texnologiya fakulteti ixtisoslashgan kafedralari va sanoat korxonalari o'rtasida doimiy hamkorlikni yo'lga qo'ygan. Korxonalarda kafedra filiallari faoliyat yuritadi, talabalar bo'sh vaqtlarida u yerga borib, darsda olgan nazariy bilimlarini amaliy tajriba bilan mustahkamlaydi. Sanoat mutaxassislari o'quv jarayonida bevosita qatnashadi, bitiruvchi talabalar bilimini baholaydi, amaliyot shartnomalarini rasmiylashtiradi va salohiyatli talabalarni ish bilan ta'minlashga sharoit yaratadi. Fakultetga texnika fanlari bo'yicha PhD, dotsent Rashid To'xtayevich Adizov rahbarlik qiladi.

Kafedrada neft va gazni qayta ishlash texnologiyasi, neft kimyosi, gazni chuqur qayta ishlash, polimerlarni qayta ishlash, korroziyadan himoya, mahsulot sifat nazorati hamda zamonaviy fizik-kimyoviy tahlil usullari o'qitiladi.

Dastlab kafedraga kimyo fanlari nomzodi M. Mardonov rahbarlik qilgan, keyinchalik Q.K. Jumaev, J.A. Qalandarov, B.Z. Adizov, Sh. Sharipov va G.R. Bozorov rahbarlik qilgan. 2019-yil 10-iyulda neft va gaz kimyo sanoati texnologiyasi negizida uchta kafedra tashkil etildi. 2025-yil 13-sentabrdan kafedrani dotsent A.A. Ochilov boshqaradi.

software-engineering.detailedDescription: The Software Engineering program at Bukhara State Technical University prepares students to design, develop, and maintain complex software systems. Students learn software design patterns, object-oriented design, Agile methodologies, cloud computing, database structures, and advanced mobile application development. The curriculum emphasizes industry-aligned practical projects.
requirements: High scores in Mathematics and Physics exams
accreditations: Uzbek Ministry of Higher Education Accreditation

cybersecurity.name: Information Systems Security & Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.detailedDescription: The Information Systems Security & Cybersecurity program at BSTU provides comprehensive education in protecting networks, computers, programs, and data from attack, damage, or unauthorized access. Students study cryptography, ethical hacking, digital forensics, network security protocols, and security compliance standards. Practical training includes laboratory simulations of cyber-attack scenarios.
requirements: High scores in national Mathematics and Informatics exams
accreditations: Ministry of Digital Technologies Professional Certificate

power-engineering.name: Power Engineering
power-engineering.detailedDescription: Power Engineering covers electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption. The curriculum focuses on electric grids, high-voltage technology, power electronics, and renewable energy integrations (solar, wind). Students practice in advanced power electronics laboratories and learn how to manage smart grids and power stations.
requirements: High scores in national Physics and Mathematics entrance exams
accreditations: IEEE Power & Energy Society Audit Endorsement
National Smart Grid Standard Alignment Certificate

mechanical-engineering.name: Mechanical Engineering
mechanical-engineering.detailedDescription: The Mechanical Engineering program at BSTU provides a comprehensive background in machine design, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, robotics, and automated manufacturing systems. Students study computer-aided engineering (CAD/CAM/CAE), materials science, and machine assembly. The program trains engineers to build and optimize mechanical systems for industrial operations.
requirements: High scores in Mathematics and Physics exams

oil-gas-engineering.name: Neft-gaz muhandisligi
oil-gas-engineering.detailedDescription: Neft-gaz muhandisligi Texnologiya fakultetida kafedra yo'nalishidagi nazariy va amaliy tayyorgarlik asosida o'qitiladi.
requirements: High scores in Chemistry and Mathematics exams
oil-gas-engineering.description: Neft-gaz muhandisligi Texnologiya fakultetida kafedra yo'nalishidagi nazariy va amaliy tayyorgarlik asosida o'qitiladi.

automotive-engineering.name: Automotive Engineering
automotive-engineering.detailedDescription: The Automotive Engineering program covers vehicle design, engine performance, transmission systems, automotive electronics, and assembly logistics. Given the scale of automotive manufacturing in Uzbekistan, this program prepares engineers to lead design and assembly lines, conduct vehicle safety audits, and implement smart transport technologies.
requirements: High scores in Physics and Mathematics exams

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.detailedDescription: The Architecture program is a rigorous 5-year curriculum blending art, history, science, and technology. Students learn architectural drawing, 3D modeling, sustainable design principles, building safety codes, and urban design. The coursework includes studio projects where students design buildings and public spaces, responding to cultural, environmental, and technological requirements.
curriculum: History of World and National Architecture
requirements: BSTU Architectural Drawing & Sketching Entrance Exam

economics.name: Economics
economics.detailedDescription: The Economics program gives students the analytical and quantitative skills to understand economic systems, market behaviors, and corporate finances. The curriculum covers econometrics, public finance, corporate strategy, international trade, and resource management. Students learn to use statistical software (SPSS, R, Excel) to model market trends and evaluate industrial investment projects.
requirements: High scores in Mathematics and Social Sciences/History exams

construction.name: Construction
construction.detailedDescription: The Construction Engineering program trains professionals in building design, construction management, and structural safety. Coursework covers soil mechanics, concrete and steel structures, quantity surveying, project scheduling, and occupational safety. Graduates are equipped to supervise construction sites, estimate project budgets, and design robust infrastructures.
requirements: High scores in national Mathematics and Physics entrance exams
Understanding of construction graphics and CAD tools

metallurgy.name: Metallurgy
metallurgy.detailedDescription: Metallurgy deals with the extraction of metals from ores, their refining, alloying, and fabrication into useful products. Students learn about physical and chemical metallurgy, material characterization techniques (microscopy, XRD), heat treatment processes, and non-destructive testing (NDT). The program highlights alloy engineering and metal recycling.
requirements: High scores in Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics entrance exams

food-technology.name: Oziq-ovqat texnologiyasi
food-technology.detailedDescription: Oziq-ovqat texnologiyasi Texnologiya fakultetida kafedra yo'nalishidagi nazariy va amaliy tayyorgarlik asosida o'qitiladi.
requirements: High scores in national Chemistry and Biology exams

textile-engineering.name: Textile Engineering
textile-engineering.detailedDescription: Textile Engineering focuses on the manufacturing of yarn, fabric, and garments from cotton, wool, and synthetic fibers. Uzbekistan is a major cotton producer, making this program highly relevant. Students study fiber physics, spinning and weaving technologies, textile dyeing, and computer-aided pattern design (CAD) for fashion and industrial garments.
requirements: High scores in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics entrance exams

electrical-power-engineering.history:
«Elektroenergetika» kafedrasi 1977 yilda M. T. Turdievning rahbarligida institut rektorining buyrug’iga asosan «Umumiy elektrotexnika» nomi bilan institutning «Umumiy texnika fanlari» kafedrasidan ajratilib tashkil etilgan. Kafedra 1978 yildan kechki bo’limga «Sanoat korxona-larining, shaharlarni va qishloq xo’jaligini elektr ta’minoti», 1985 yildan kafedra kunduzgi bo’limga «Elektroenergetika», 1998 yildan «Elektroenergetika» yo’nalishi muallim-energetiklar, 2000 yildan kafedrada «Elektr ta’minoti» (sohalar bo’yicha) msgistratura mutaxassisligi bo’yicha talabalar qabul qila boshlandi.
Kafedraga Turdiyev M. T. 1977-1985 yillar va 1994-2005 yillar, 1985 yildan 1994 yilgacha Abdullaev A. M., 2005 yildan 2011 yilgacha Sadullaev N. N., 2011-2018 yillar Maxmudov M. I., 2018-2019 yillar Xafizov I. I. mudirlik qildi.
O'zbekiston Respublikasi Oliy va o'rta maxsus ta'lim vazirligining 2019 yil 10 iyuldagi buyrug'iga asosan yangi 3 ta kafedra tashkil qilindi. “Elektr mexanikasi va texnologiyalari” kafedrasiga dotsent I.I.Xafizov mudirligida (2019 - 2024 yillar), “Energetika” kafedrasiga dotsent R.B.Jalilov mudirligida (2019 - 2024 yillar), va “Energoaudit” kafedrasida M.I. Mahmudov mudirligida (2019 - 2024 yillar) mutaxassislar tayyorlandi.
2024-2025 o’quv yilida Universitet ichki tuzilmasida o’zgarishlar natijasida 3 ta kafedra negizida 1 ta “Elektr va energetika muhandisligi” kafedrasi tashkil qilindi. 2024-2025 o’quv yilida N.N. Mirzayev mudir sifatida faoliyat olib bordi. 2025-2026 o’quv yilining boshidan hozirgi kungacha dotsent Latipov Saidmurod Tuyg’unovich rahbarlik qilib kelmoqda.
electrical-power-engineering.research: Kafedrada ilmiy tadqiqot ishlariga 2 nafar fan doktori, 3 nafar PhD, 6 nafar katta o'qituvchi hamda mustaqil tadqiqotchilar va magistrlar jalb qilingan. Davlat ilmiy-texnika dasturi doirasidagi 2021-2023 yillarga mo'ljallangan ILM-20215001-«Kichik quvvatli iste'molchilar uchun O'zbekiston iqlimiy sharoitlarida samarador ishlovchi shamol energetik qurilmasini yaratish» loyihasi asosida 500 mln. so'mlik davlat granti olindi. Bundan tashqari, 9 ta korxona bilan 92 mln so'mlik xo'jalik shartnomalari bajarildi. Akademik innovatsion grant doirasida Portaflow 330 va Testo 330-1LL jihozlari olingan.

architecture.history: O'zbekiston Respublikasi birinchi Prezidenti I.A.Karimov 2008 yilning aprelida Buxoro viloyatidagi tashrifi chog'ida milliy arxitektura me'rosini tushunadigan va ularga monand zamonaviy binolarni loyihalashni tashkil etish bo'yicha ko'rsatmalar berdi. Vazirlikning 2008 yil 2 maydagi buyrug'iga asosan institut tarkibida 'Arxitektura-qurilish' fakulteti va 'Arxitektura' ta'lim yo'nalishi ochildi. 2009 yil 29 avgustda fakultet tarkibida 'Arxitektura' kafedrasi tashkil qilindi. Bugungi kunda kafedrada 20 nafar professor-o'qituvchilar faoliyat ko'rsatmoqda, shundan 1 nafar fan doktori, 4 nafar fan nomzodi va 5 nafar katta o'qituvchi.
architecture.research: Kafedrada Buxoroning tarixiy g'ishtli binolarini tiklash, binolar fizikasi, iqlimga mos loyihalash va yashil qurilish texnologiyalari bo'yicha ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlari olib borilmoqda. Tadqiqotlar Buxoro viloyat madaniy meros boshqarmasi va qurilish tashkilotlari bilan hamkorlikda amalga oshiriladi.

civil-engineering.history: «Qurilish muhandisligi» kafedrasi eng birinchilar qatorida, Toshkent Politexnika institutining Buxoro umumtexnika fakultetida tayanch kafedra sifatida 1962 yildan faoliyat ko'rsatib kelmoqda. Kafedraning ko'p yillik faoliyatida 40 dan ortiq ilmiy salohiyatli professor va dotsentlar yetishib chiqqan va kadrlar tayyorlashda o'z hissasini qo'shib kelmoqda. Bugungi kunda kafedrada 32 nafar professor-o'qituvchilar faoliyat ko'rsatmoqda, shundan 2 nafar fan doktori, 15 nafar fan nomzodi va 15 nafar katta o'qituvchi.
civil-engineering.research: Kafedrada mahalliy materiallar asosida tarixiy obidalar restavratsiyasi uchun quruq qorishmalar ishlab chiqish, bo'sh gruntlarni sementlash usulida mustahkamlash, yashil tomlar barpo etish va issiq iqlim sharoitida betonlash texnologiyalari bo'yicha ilmiy ishlar olib borilmoqda. So'nggi yillarda 7 ta darslik, 4 ta monografiya va 2 ta patent olindi.

monitoring-internal-control.name: Monitoring va ichki nazorat bo'limi
monitoring-internal-control.headTitle: Monitoring va ichki nazorat bo'limi boshlig'i
monitoring-internal-control.about: O'z faoliyatida bo'lim O'zbekiston Respublikasi Qonunlari, O'zbekiston Respublikasi Prezidentining Farmonlari, Qarorlari va Farmoyishlariga, Vazirlar Mahkamasining qaror va farmoyishlariga, ushbu Nizomga hamda rektor buyruqlariga rioya qiladi. Bo'lim institut bo'linmalari tomonidan murojaatlarning o'z vaqtida va tegishli tarzda ko'rib chiqilishini doimiy rasmiy ravishda nazorat qiladi.
functions: Ushbu Nizomga muvofiq bo'limga bevosita rahbarlik qiladi, bo'lim xodimlari ishini tashkil qiladi va yuklatilgan vazifalar bajarilishi uchun to'liq javob beradi.
Bo'lim faoliyatini takomillashtirish hamda xodimlarning malakasini oshirish choralarini ko'radi.
Ijro.gov.uz va Edo.ijro.uz tizimlari orqali qonunchilik hujjatlari va topshiriqlarning o'z vaqtida bajarilishini nazorat qiladi, tahliliy hisobotlarni rektorga taqdim etadi.
Ijro intizomini mustahkamlash va mas'ul shaxslarning javobgarligini oshirish bo'yicha rektorga takliflar kiritadi.
Ijro intizomini buzgan xodimlarga nisbatan intizomiy jazo choralarini qo'llash bo'yicha takliflar tayyorlaydi.
Institut kafedralari va fakultetlarida ijro intizomi holatini tizimli o'rganishni tashkil qiladi.
Jismoniy va yuridik shaxslarning murojaatlarini ko'rib chiqadi va ijro intizomiga qat'iy rioya qiladi.
Bo'lim ishini yanada takomillashtirish chora-tadbirlarini ishlab chiqadi va amalga oshiradi.
Prezident Administratsiyasi, Vazirlar Mahkamasi va vazirliklardan kelgan hujjatlarning ro'yxatga olinishi va yetkazilishini nazorat qiladi.
Xodimlarning sifatli ish faoliyatini bo'lim ish rejasi va xizmat vazifalariga muvofiq muvofiqlashtiradi.
Rahbariyat faoliyatini hujjatlashtirish, xatlar jo'natish va ichki hujjatlarni rasmiylashtirishni nazorat qiladi.
Institut bo'linmalarida ish yuritish bo'yicha amaliy va uslubiy yordam ko'rsatadi.
Hujjat aylanishi va ish yuritish tartiblarini yaxshilash bo'yicha hamkorlik qiladi.
Prezident farmonlari va qarorlari bilan yuklatilgan topshiriqlar bajarilishini tizimli nazorat qiladi;
Vazirlar Mahkamasi qaror va farmoyishlari ijrosini sifatli va o'z vaqtida nazorat qiladi;
Prezident Administratsiyasidan kelgan topshiriqlar va yig'ilish bayonnomalari ijrosini nazorat qiladi;
Oliy ta'lim vazirligi hujjatlari (buyruqlar, topshiriqlar va xatlar) bajarilishini monitoring qiladi;
Rektor buyruqlarining tarkibiy bo'linmalar tomonidan o'z vaqtida va sifatli bajarilishini nazorat qiladi;
Vazirlik buyruqlari va Kengash qarorlari ijrosini nazorat qilib, har oy va har chorakda hisobot beradi;
'Jismoniy va yuridik shaxslarning murojaatlari to'g'risida'gi Qonun talablari asosida murojaatlar ko'rib chiqilishini doimiy nazorat qiladi;
Murojaatlarni ko'rib chiqish muddati va tartibi buzilganda rektorni zudlik bilan xabardor qiladi;
Rektorga qonunchilik hujjatlari, topshiriqlar va murojaatlar ijrosi bo'yicha zarur ma'lumotlarni taqdim etadi;
Qonunlar, farmonlar va yig'ilish bayonnomalari ijrosi holatini muntazam tahlil qilib, muammolarni Kengash muhokamasiga kiritadi;
Virtual qabulxonalar va boshqa tashkilotlardan kelgan murojaatlarni ro'yxatga oladi va ijrochilarga yetkazadi;
Murojaat mualliflariga belgilangan muddatlarda javob xatlari yuborilishini nazorat qiladi;
Jismoniy va yuridik shaxslarni qabul qilish jadvalini ishlab chiqadi va qabullarni tashkil etadi;
Murojaatlarni ko'rib chiqish holati bo'yicha har oy, har chorak va yillik tahlillarni rektorga taqdim etadi;
Murojaatlar bo'yicha tahliliy ma'lumotlarni tayyorlaydi va vazirlikka choraklik hisobotlarni yuboradi;
Institut tarkibidagi litsey va texnikumlarda hujjatlar va topshiriqlar ijrosini nazorat qiladi;
Bo'lim faoliyatiga doir murojaatlar bilan tizimli ishlaydi va ijro intizomini mustahkamlaydi.

personnel-department.name: Xodimlar bo'limi (Kadrlar)
personnel-department.about: Universitet bo'linmalarini malakali kadrlar bilan ta'minlash, xodimlarning hisobini yuritish va mehnat intizomini nazorat qilish bilan shug'ullanadi.
functions: Universitet bo'linmalarini malakali va tajribali kadrlar bilan ta'minlash;
Professor-o'qituvchilar va xodimlar ma'lumotlarini elektron bazada yangilab borish;
Barcha kadrlar ma'lumotlarini tegishli tizimlarga (jumladan HEMIS) kiritish;
Kadrlardan o'z lavozimlarida samarali foydalanish va ularning hisobini yuritish;
Barcha universitet xodimlarining kelib-ketishi va ish vaqtini nazorat qilish;
Kadrlar yetishmovchiligini tahlil qilish va takliflar tayyorlash;
Yuqori tashkilotlardan kelgan topshiriqlarni o'z vaqtida bajarish;
Kadrlar masalalariga oid hujjatlarni tayyorlashda ishtirok etish;
Professor-o'qituvchilar, xodimlar va talabalarning shaxsiy yig'ma jildlarini saqlash;
Fakultet dekanlari va kafedra mudirlarini saylash muddatlarini belgilash va nazorat qilish;
Xodimlar uchun ma'lumotnomalar tayyorlashni tashkil etish;
Oliy ta'lim vazirligi va boshqa tashkilotlarga kadrlar bo'yicha hisobotlar tayyorlash;
Ishga qabul qilish, bo'shatish va lavozimini o'zgartirish bo'yicha buyruq loyihalarini tayyorlash;
Vazirlikdan olingan diplom blanklarini saqlash va hisobini yuritish;
Dekanlar tomonidan tayyorlangan buyruqlarning ro'yxatga olinishini nazorat qilish;
Kasaba uyushmasi bilan kelishilgan holda mehnat intizomini buzganlarni ishdan bo'shatishni nazorat qilish;
Talabalar bo'limida shaxsiy hujjatlar va talaba kartalarini nazorat qilish;
Dekanlar tayyorlagan talabalar buyruqlarini kelishilgan holda imzolash;
Kadrlar bo'limi tomonidan tayyorlanadigan barcha hisobotbiy ma'lumotlarning o'z vaqtida topshirilishini nazorat qilish;
Ishdan bo'shagan xodimlar va bitirgan talabalarning shaxsiy hujjatlarini arxivga topshirish;
Qabul komissiyasidan 1-kurs talabalari va magistrlarning shaxsiy hujjatlarini qabul qilib olishni nazorat qilish.

office-archive.name: Devonxona va arxiv bo'limi
office-archive.about: Devonxona institut mustaqil tarkibiy bo'linmasi bo'lib, o'z faoliyatida amaldagi qonunchilik va me'yoriy hujjatlarga tayanadi. Keluvchi va ketuvchi xatlarni, ichki buyruqlarni ro'yxatdan o'tkazish hamda arxiv ishlarini boshqaradi.
functions: Institutda ish yuritish jarayonlarini tashkil etish, hujjatlar intizomini ta'minlash va maxfiylikni saqlash.
Yuqori tashkilotlardan kelgan hujjatlarning bajarilish muddati va sifatini nazorat qilish.
Xodimlarga yuklatilgan hujjatlarning o'z vaqtida bajarilishini ta'minlash.
Hujjat aylanishida muhr va shtamplardan to'g'ri foydalanish va ularni saqlashni nazorat qilish.
Rahbariyat qarorlari ijrosini monitoring qibly borish.
Saqlash muddati tugagan hujjatlarni o'z vaqtida arxivga topshirishni tashkil etish.
Institut bo'linmalarida hujjatlar yuritilishini o'rganish va nazorat qilish.
Kafedralar va dekanatlarda hujjatlarning to'g'ri ro'yxatga olinishini nazorat qilish.
Xatlarni qabul qilish va javob xatlarini o'z vaqtida jo'natish.
Hujjatlarni dekanat va kafedralarga tarqatish hamda ijrosini nazorat qilish.
Devonxona va arxiv xodimlari malakasini oshirish choralarini ko'rish.
Bo'lim xodimlari o'z majburiyatlarini halol bajarishi va mehnat intizomiga rioya qilishi lozim.
Oliy Majlis, Prezident Administratsiyasi va vazirliklardan kelgan hujjatlarni o'z vaqtida ijrochilarga yetkazish.
Institutdan chiquvchi hujjatlarning to'g'ri rasmiylashtirilishini ta'minlash.
Kelgan hujjatlarni edo.ijro.uz tizimi orqali zudlik bilan ijrochilarga yo'naltirish.
Rektor buyruqlari asosida hujjatlarni o'z vaqtida mas'ullarga yetkazish va hisobot berish.

digital-educational-technologies.name: Raqamli ta'lim texnologiyalari markazi
digital-educational-technologies.about: Markaz universitetning axborot tizimlari, kompyuter tarmoqlari va dasturiy ta'minotlarini ishlab chiqish hamda qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan shug'ullanadi. Universitetda ta'lim jarayonini avtomatlashtirish bo'yicha keng ko'lamli ishlar olib borilmoqda. Kompyuter sinflari va Wi-Fi zonalari mavjud.
functions: Raqamli ta'lim texnologiyalarini joriy etish bo'limi;
Tarmoqlarni boshqarish bo'limi;
Texnik qo'llab-quvvatlash bo'limi;
Axborot xavfsizligi bo'limi;
Ta'lim jarayonlarini avtomatlashtirish, elektron jurnal va masofaviy ta'lim (Moodle) tizimini yuritish;
Talabalar uchun Wi-Fi zonalarini yaratish va internet tezligini ta'minlash;
Kompyuter sinflari va AKT uskunalariga texnik xizmat ko'rsatish;
Provayderlar va yetkazib beruvchilar bilan shartnomaviy munosabatlarni yuritish.

educational-quality-control.name: Ta'lim sifatini nazorat qilish bo'limi
educational-quality-control.headTitle: Ta'lim sifatini nazorat qilish bo'limi boshlig'i
educational-quality-control.about: Ushbu Nizom bo'limning maqomi, asosiy maqsadlari, vazifalari, huquq va majburiyatlarini belgilaydi. Bo'lim bevosita universitet rektoriga bo'ysunadi va o'z vakolatlari doirasida faoliyat yuritadi.
functions: Kadrlar tayyorlash sifatini nazorat qilish va muvofiqlashtirish, o'quv jarayonini davlat standartlariga muvofiqlashtirish;
Talabalar bilimining davlat ta'lim standartlari va talablariga muvofiqligini o'rganish va tahlil qilish;
Malakali o'qituvchilarni tanlash, ishga qabul qilish va ularning kasbiy rivojlanishi uchun shaffof mexanizmlarni yaratish;
Professor-o'qituvchilar dars berish sifatini muntazam tahlil qilish;
Universitetning ichki baholash jarayonlarini tashkil etish va kamchiliklarni bartaraf etish choralarini ko'rish;
O'quv jarayonini me'yoriy hujjatlarga muvofiq tashkil etish va HEMIS tizimi samaradorligini monitoring qilish;
Kvalifikatsion talablar, o'quv rejalari va dasturlarining mehnat bozori talablariga muvofiqligini tahlil qilish;
Bitiruvchilarning mehnat bozoridagi o'rni bo'yicha takliflar tayyorlash;
Darslarda zamonaviy pedagogik texnologiyalar va multimedia vositalaridan foydalanishni nazorat qilish;
Amaliyotlarga ishlab chiqarish korxonalaridan malakali mutaxassislarni jalb etishni monitoring qilish;
Talabalar bilimini baholashda shaffoflik va adolatni ta'minlash choralarini baholash;
Kafedralarda dars yuklamalarining adolatli taqsimlanishini tahlil qilish;
Axborot-resurs markazida talabalar va o'qituvchilar uchun yaratilgan sharoitlarni tahlil qilish;
Mustaqil ta'lim jarayonlarini tashkil etish va ko'rsatmalar ishlab chiqish;
Universitetda anti-plagiat dasturlarini joriy etish va akademik halollikni ta'minlash;
Vazirlik topshiriqlariga binoan boshqa OTMlar faoliyatini o'rganishda ishtirok etish;
Olimpiadalar va turli tanlovlarning adolatli o'tkazilishini nazorat qilish va tahlil qilish;
Ta'lim sifatini baholash sohasida xalqaro hamkorlikni yo'lga qo'yish;
Ijtimoiy so'rovnomalar o'tkazish orqali ta'lim sifati va dars berish darajasini o'rganish.

academic-affairs-management.name: O'quv-uslubiy bo'lim
academic-affairs-management.about: Universitetning o'quv ishlarini boshqaradi, dars jarayonlarini o'quv rejalari asosida tashkil etadi hamda professor-o'qituvchilar yuklamaiarining bajarilishini nazorat qiladi.
functions: Bo'limning barcha faoliyati va xodimlarini umumiy boshqarish;
Universitetning o'quv ishlarini vazirlik tomonidan belgilangan o'quv rejalari asosida boshqarish va tashkil etish;
O'quv rejalari va dasturlarini takomillashtirish ishlarini tashkil etish;
Talabalar bilimini baholash va zamonaviy usullarni joriy etishni nazorat qilish;
Professor-o'qituvchilar tarkibining o'quv yuklamalari bajarilishini monitoring qilish;
Zamonaviy va ilg'or pedagogik tajribalarni o'rganish va ommalashtirish;
Fakultetlarda o'quv jarayoni tashkil etilishini o'rganish va kamchiliklarni bartaraf etish bo'yicha ko'rsatmalar berish;
Yosh o'qituvchilarning malakasini oshirish va tajriba orttirishini tashkil etish;
Pedagogik xodimlar ma'lumotlar bazasini shakllantirish;
Professor-o'qituvchilarning malaka oshirish rejalari bajarilishini nazorat qilish;
Bitiruvchilarni ishga joylashtirish ishlarida ishtirok etish;
Talabalarning pedagogik va ishlab chiqarish amaliyotlarini tashkil etish va nazorat qilish;
Qabul komissiyasi ishida ishtirok etish va qabul natijalarini umumlashtirish;
Fakultet va kafedralar hisobotlarini qabul qilish va yangi kafedralar ochish bo'yicha takliflar berish.

scientific-research-department.name: Ilmiy-tadqiqotlar, innovatsiyalar va ilmiy-pedagogik kadrlarni tayyorlash bo'limi
scientific-research-department.about: Bo'lim 1982-yilda tashkil etilgan bo'lib, universitetning ilmiy-tadqiqot faoliyati va ilmiy kadrlar tayyorlash ishlarini muvofiqlashtiradi hamda ishlab chiqarish korxonalari bilan ilmiy hamkorlikni yo'lga qo'yadi.
functions: Universitetda ilmiy-tadqiqot faoliyatini tashkil etish va muvofiqlashtirish;
Xalq xo'jaligini rivojlantirish uchun universitet ilmiy salohiyatidan samarali foydalanish;
Yangi materiallar, uskunalar va texnologiyalar yaratish bo'yicha ilmiy tadqiqotlarni rivojlantirish;
Ilmiy tadqiqotlar natijalarini o'quv jarayoniga tatbiq etish orqali kadrlar tayyorlash sifatini oshirish;
Ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlarining moddiy-texnika bazasini mustahkamlash;
Raqobatbardosh texnologiyalar yaratish bo'yicha ilmiy-texnik hamkorlikni birlashtirish;
Fundamental va amaliy tadqiqotlar natijalarini ishlab chiqarishga joriy etish;
Talabalar va iqtidorli yoshlarning ilmiy-texnik ijodkorligini qo'llab-quvvatlash.

masters-department.name: Magistratura bo'limi
masters-department.about: Magistratura bo'limi universitetda magistrlar tayyorlash bo'yicha o'quv-uslubiy, ilmiy-tadqiqot va ma'naviy-tarbiyaviy jarayonlarni muvofiqlashtiradi. Hozirda 25 ta mutaxassislik bo'yicha magistrlar tayyorlanmoqda.
functions: Bo'limning o'quv, uslubiy, ma'naviy va ilmiy faoliyatini bevosita boshqarish;
Magistrlarning ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlarini olib borishini yo'naltirish va muvofiqlashtirish;
Magistrlarning amaliyoti, dissertatsiyalari va mustaqil ishlari sifatini nazorat qilish;
Magistratura tizimini rivojlantirish bo'yicha dasturlar va loyihalarni ishlab chiqish;
Vazirlar Mahkamasi tomonidan tasdiqlangan Magistratura to'g'risidagi Nizom talablariga rioya etilishini ta'minlash;
Magistrlarni kafedralarning ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlariga laboratoriya yordamchisi yoki assistent sifatida jalb etish.

legal-service.name: Yuridik xizmat bo'limi
legal-service.about: Universitetda qabul qilinayotgan buyruq va qarorlarning amaldagi qonunchilikka muvofiqligini nazorat qiladi hamda shartnomalarning qonuniy rasmiylashtirilishini ta'minlaydi.
functions: Hujjatlar va qaror loyihalarining qonunchilikka muvofiqligini tekshirish va tasdiqlash;
Rektor imzolaydigan buyruq va ko'rsatmalarning huquqiy talablarga mosligini tekshirish;
Qonunbuzarliklarni aniqlash va ularni bartaraf etish choralarini ko'rish;
Jamoa shartnomalarini tayyorlash va rasmiylashtirishda ishtirok etish;
Tuzilayotgan shartnomalarning qonuniy va to'g'ri rasmiylashtirilishini ta'minlash;
Xodimlar va talabalarning huquqiy savodxonligini oshirish bo'yicha targ'ibot ishlarini olib borish;
Fuqarolar va xodimlarni huquqiy masalalar bo'yicha qabul qilish va maslahat berish;
Universitetning me'yoriy-huquqiy hujjatlar bazasini huquqiy jihatdan yangilab borish va saqlash;
Huquqni muhofaza qilish organlari va sudlarda universitet manfaatlarini himoya qilish;
Debitorlik qarzlarini bartaraf etish bo'yicha hamkorlik qilish;
Universitet faoliyati natijalarini ko'rib chiquvchi komissiyalar ishida ishtirok etish;
Universitetga yetkazilgan moddiy zararni undirish bo'yicha hujjatlarni tayyorlash.

youth-spirituality-enlightenment.name: Yoshlar bilan ishlash, ma'naviyat va ma'rifat bo'limi
youth-spirituality-enlightenment.about: Talaba-yoshlarni vatanparvarlik va milliy qadriyatlarga sodiqlik ruhida tarbiyalash, ularning ma'naviy-axloqiy dunyoqarashini kengaytirish hamda bo'sh vaqtlarini mazmunli tashkil etish bilan shug'ullanadi.
functions: Talabalarni milliy va umuminsoniy qadriyatlar ruhida, vatanparvar etib tarbiyalash;
Talabalarning o'z kasbiga bo'lgan mas'uliyatini oshirish;
Talabalarning ijtimoiy faolligini, tashabbuskorligini va kasbga hurmatini oshirish;
Siyosiy-huquqiy ongni shakllantirish va tanqidiy fikrlashni rivojlantirish;
Adolatsizlik, ta'magirlik va korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashish bo'yicha tushuntirish ishlarini olib borish;
Talabalarning bo'sh vaqtlarini mazmunli tashkil etish va to'garaklar faoliyatini yo'lga qo'yish;
Ma'naviy-axloqiy va tarbiyaviy ishlarni takomillashtirish;
Diniy ekstremizm, terrorizm va giyohvandlikka qarshi g'oyaviy immunitetni shakllantirish;
Yoshlar o'rtasida kitobxonlik va mutolaa madaniyatini targ'ib qilish;
Xotin-qizlar va talaba qizlarning kasb-hunar o'rganishlariga ko'maklashish.

civil-and-labor-protection.name: Fuqaro muhofazasi va mehnat muhofazasi bo'limi
civil-and-labor-protection.about: Mehnat xavfsizligi va fuqaro muhofazasi chora-tadbirlarini ishlab chiqish hamda universitet hududida texnika xavfsizligi qoidalariga rioya etilishini nazorat qilish bo'limi.
functions: Universitetda baxtsiz hodisalar va kasb kasalliklari sabablarini tahlil qilish hamda ularni oldini olish choralarini ko'rish;
Mehnatni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha ilmiy ishlanmalar va standartlarni joriy etish;
Xodimlarning texnika xavfsizligi va mehnat muhofazasi qoidalari bo'yicha bilimlarini tekshirishda ishtirok etish;
Mehnat muhofazasi bo'yicha yo'riqnomalar ishlab chiqish va xodimlarga o'rgatish;
O'quv jarayoni va ishlab chiqarishda yuz bergan baxtsiz hodisalarni tekshirishda ishtirok etish;
Mehnat muhofazasi masalalari bo'yicha buyruq loyihalarini tayyorlash;
Talabalar va xodimlar uchun maslahat kengashlari o'tkazish;
Mehnat muhofazasiga oid arizalar va murojaatlarni ko'rib chiqish va choralar ko'rish;
Belgilangan ish ro'yxati bo'yicha hujjatlarni yuritish;
Mehnat muhofazasi bo'yicha hisobotlarni topshirish.

trade-union-committee.name: Kasaba uyushmasi qo'mitasi
trade-union-committee.about: Kasaba uyushmasi universitet xodimlari va talabalarining ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy, mehnat hamda texnika xavfsizligi sohasidagi huquq va manfaatlarini himoya qiladi.
functions: Jamoa shartnomalarini tuzish va ularning bajarilishini nazorat qilish;
Mehnat qonunchiligi va xavfsizlik qoidalariga rioya etilishini ta'minlash;
Kasaba uyushmasi a'zolariga huquqiy va ijtimoiy maslahatlar berish;
Xodimlar va talabalar o'rtasida madaniy, jismoniy tarbiya va sog'lomlashtirish tadbirlarini tashkil etish.

gifted-students-research.name: Iqtidorli talabalar ilmiy-tadqiqot faoliyatini tashkil etish bo'limi
gifted-students-research.about: Iqtidorli talabalarning ilmiy-tadqiqot faoliyatini tashkil etish, ularning intellektual salohiyatini oshirish hamda ijodiy va ilmiy tashabbuslarini qo'llab-quvvatlash bo'limi.
functions: Universitetda iqtidorli va tashabbuskor yoshlarning yagona ma'lumotlar bazasini yaratish;
Iqtidorli talabalarning intellektual salohiyatini aniqlash;
Iqtidorli talabalar uchun maqsadli o'quv darslarini tashkil etish;
Startap va innovatsion loyihalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash hamda biznes-inkubatorlarni tashkil etish;
Iqtidorli yoshlarning xorijiy ilmiy markazlar va korxonalarda tajriba orttirishiga ko'maklashish;
Universitetda yangi avlod ilmiy maktablari va jamoalarini shakllantirish;
Ilmiy tadqiqotlar o'tkazish bo'yicha metodologiya va ko'nikmalarni egallash uchun sharoit yaratish;
Talabalarni davlat stipendiyalari va nufuzli tanlovlarga tayyorlash;
Talabalarni ilmiy loyihalarga keng jalb etish.

inclusive-it-center.name: Inklyuziv IT markazi
inclusive-it-center.about: Imkoniyati cheklangan talabalar va ijtimoiy himoyaga muhtoj yoshlar uchun axborot texnologiyalari, veb-dizayn va dasturlash bo'yicha bepul o'quv kurslarini tashkil etadi.
functions: Veb va mobil ilovalarni loyihalash bo'yicha seminarlar tashkil etish;
Kompyuter savodxonligi va dasturlash bo'yicha intensiv kurslar o'tkazish;
Bitiruvchilarni masofaviy ishlar bilan ta'minlash bo'yicha hamkorlik qilish;
Moslashuvchan texnologiyalar va raqamli inklyuzivlik ko'rgazmalarini tashkil etish.

professional-development-center.name: Malaka oshirish va qayta tayyorlash markazi
professional-development-center.about: Professor-o'qituvchilar va soha mutaxassislari uchun kasbiy qayta tayyorlash va pedagogik mahoratni oshirish kurslarini tashkil etadi.
functions: Professor-o'qituvchilar uchun qayta tayyorlash kurslarini tashkil etish;
Kasbiy qayta tayyorlash va malaka oshirish sertifikatlarini berish;
Korxona xodimlari uchun maxsus o'quv kurslari va seminarlar o'tkazish;
Ta'lim dasturlari sifatini monitoring qilib borish.

information-resource-center.name: Axborot-resurs markazi (Kutubxona)
information-resource-center.about: Universitetning asosiy kutubxonasi va raqamli ma'lumotlar bazasi hisoblanadi. Kutubxona fondida 250 000 dan ortiq jismoniy kitoblar, darsliklar va ilmiy ma'lumotlar bazalariga (Scopus, Web of Science) kirish imkoniyati mavjud.
functions: Darsliklar va ilmiy adabiyotlar fondini yangilab borish;
Xalqaro ilmiy ma'lumotlar bazalariga kirishni ta'minlash;
Kitob ko'rgazmalari va talabalar o'rtasida mutolaa tanlovlarini o'tkazish;
Talabalar va tadqiqotchilar uchun qulay o'quv zallarini tashkil etish.

international-cooperation-department.name: Xalqaro hamkorlik bo'limi
international-cooperation-department.about: Universitetning xalqaro aloqalari, xorijiy hamkorlik shartnomalari, chet ellik talabalar qabuli va almashinuv dasturlarini muvofiqlashtiradi.
functions: Xorijiy talabalar qabuli va hujjatlarini rasmiylashtirish;
Talabalar va o'qituvchilar almashinuv dasturlari logistikasini yuritish;
Xalqaro konferensiyalar va xorijiy delegatsiyalar tashrifini tashkil etish;
Xalqaro shartnomalar va qo'shma ta'lim dasturlari bazasini yuritish.

anti-corruption-compliance.name: Korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashish compliance nazorat tizimini boshqarish bo'limi
anti-corruption-compliance.about: Universitetda akademik halollikni ta'minlash, manfaatlar to'qnashuvining oldini olish va barcha imtihonlar hamda moliyaviy jarayonlar shaffofligini nazorat qilish bo'limi.
functions: Imtihonlar va baholash shaffofligini ta'minlash, korrupsion holatlarni oldini olish;
Anonim murojaat qilish kanallarini yuritish va tahlil qilish;
Xodimlar va talabalar uchun odob-ahloq qoidalari bo'yicha seminarlar o'tkazish;
Murojaatlarni o'rganish va نتائج bo'yicha rektorga hisobot berish.

youth-union-organization.name: O'zbekiston Yoshlar ittifoqi boshlang'ich tashkiloti
youth-union-organization.about: Buxoro davlat texnika universitetida Yoshlar ittifoqi boshlang'ich tashkiloti 2017-yilda tashkil etilgan. Tashkilot talabalarning huquq va manfaatlarini himoya qilish hamda ularning ijtimoiy faolligini oshirish bilan shug'ullanadi.
functions: Boshlang'ich tashkilot faoliyatini boshqarish va yetakchilik qilish;
Iqtidorli va faol yoshlar bilan ishlash yo'nalishini muvofiqlashtirish;
Talabalarning murojaatlari bilan ishlash va ularning tashabbuslarini qo'llab-quvvatlash;

information-service.name: Axborot xizmati
information-service.about: BuxDTU Axborot xizmati universitetning akademik yutuqlarini keng yoritish, rasmiy jamoatchilik bilan aloqalarni, press-relizlarni va media tadbirlarini boshqarish hamda jamoatchilikni universitet faoliyatidan xabardor qilib borish uchun mas'uldir.
functions: Rasmiy press-relizlar va yangiliklar byulletenlarini tayyorlash hamda tarqatish
Universitetning ommaviy axborot vositalaridagi chiqishlarini boshqarish va matbuot anjumanlarini muvofiqlashtirish
OAVdagi chiqishlarni monitoring qilish va universitetning rasmiy ijtimoiy tarmoq kanallarini boshqarish
Universitetning yirik tadbirlarida fotosuratchi va videoperatorlar ishini muvoyiqlashtirish

vocational-education-coordination.name: Professional ta'limni muvofiqlashtirish bo'limi
vocational-education-coordination.about: Ushbu bo'lim BuxDTU hamda viloyatdagi akademik litseylar va kasb-hunar kollejlari o'rtasidagi hamkorlikni muvofiqlashtiradi, ta'lim yo'nalishlarining uzviyligini ta'minlaydi va bo'lajak talabalar uchun kasbga yo'naltirish ishlarini olib boradi.
functions: Kasb-hunar kollejlari bilan hamkorlikda qo'shma o'quv seminarlari va o'quv dasturlari almashinuvini muvofiqlashtirish
Litsey o'quvchilari uchun universitetda ochiq eshiklar kunlari va kasbga yo'naltirish tadbirlarini tashkil etish
Hamkor akademik litseylarda ta'lim sifati va ularni metodik qo'llab-quvvatlashni nazorat qilish
Viloyat o'rta maxsus texnik muassasalarida talabalarni jalb qilish kampaniyalarini yo'lga qo'yish

labor-protection-safety.name: Mehnat muhofazasi va xavfsizlik texnikasi bo'limi
labor-protection-safety.headTitle: Mehnat muhofazasi va xavfsizlik texnikasi bo'limi boshlig'i
labor-protection-safety.about: Ushbu bo'lim universitet hududida mehnat xavfsizligi qoidalariga rioya etilishi, laboratoriyalar xavfsizligi, favqulodda vaziyatlarga tayyorgarlik va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish ko'rsatmalarining bajarilishini ta'minlaydi.
functions: Kampus xodimlari va laboratoriya mutaxassislari uchun majburiy xavfsizlik o'quvlarini o'tkazish
O'quv laboratoriyalari, ustaxonalar va xonalarni xavfli omillar mavjudligi yuzasidan tekshirish
Yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfsizlik qoidabuzarliklarini o'rganish va xavfsizlik uskunalarini yangilash
Universitetda yong'in xavfsizligi mashg'ulotlari va favqulodda vaziyatlarga qarshi harakatlarni muvofiqlashtirish

faculty-of-natural-resources-management.name: Tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish fakulteti
faculty-of-natural-resources-management.about: Tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish fakulteti suv resurslari muhandisligi, irrigatsiya, yer kadastri, atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish va avtomobil muhandisligi bo'yicha mutaxassislar tayyorlaydi. Fakultet O'rta Osiyo quruq iqlimi sharoitida suv xo'jaligi, melioratsiya, ekologiya va qishloq xo'jaligini mexanizatsiyalash sohalarida murakkab muammolarni hal etishga qaratilgan tajribali professor-o'qituvchi xodimlardan iborat.
